newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales slow at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales slow at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow. Few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand moderate, USDA said.
Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 93,600 head including 24,900 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1250 lbs $64.00 per cwt.
Slaughter heifers Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 64.00.
